review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently specify opt-in, default-false input trimming before existing case handling, unchanged vocabulary whitespace, existing non-string errors, boolean output inference, and preserved encode normalization, first-entry selection, and empty-entry fallback. The source places the shared parameter declaration and decode transform in core/api.ts; classic and mini already consume that shared parameter type and forward arguments. The exact writable scope therefore appropriately comprises core/api.ts and the two regression files, while utility, factory, and export consumers remain inspection owners rather than mandatory edits. The package build/export configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. The supplied TypeScript and Vitest configurations establish a separate compiler-backed checking route covering the regression files; compile-mode runtime testing is not mistaken for type checking. The stable implementation and independent-verification task keys, verification dependency, and required acceptance coverage are coherent. Both allowed assignees have the relevant active trusted capability claims, including data.change; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy mappings and persona descriptions are not needed to establish eligibility. An independent, active, non-assignable project reviewer is configured for the earlier review prerequisite. No unresolved material DEC-001 is supplied for this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; a material unresolved decision would instead block at decisions, and a fixed hypothetical input would not constitute human resolution. Repository identity and commit agree throughout. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source-manifest, evaluation-source, and whitespace-normalized PRD digest domains. Historical operations are explicitly old-version records, not fresh candidates on this bundle, and scoped project reuse preserves rather than copies attestations. This assessment uses only the supplied review data: I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or provide human attestation.
